steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Send the application form on this site or message the academy on WhatsApp with the student’s name, guardian email, WhatsApp number, class, track and any past contest experience.

steps.title: Diagnostic
steps.description: The academy arranges a short written diagnostic. It is a placement test, not a pass/fail entrance exam. The length and format are confirmed when the test is arranged.

steps.title: Placement confirmed in writing
steps.description: The division, tier, session and monthly fee are confirmed in writing before the first class. If a batch is on hold, the academy will offer the running alternative or the next intake.

steps.title: First class
steps.description: The student attends the first class and begins the weekly problem sets. The first monthly benchmark follows at the end of the month.

diagnostic.heading: About the diagnostic
diagnostic.summary: The diagnostic tells us what the student can do now. It is not a test to cram for.
points: It places the student by ability, not by school class.
A strong student can be placed above their school grade; a student who needs consolidation can be placed below it.
The result is a division and tier: Primary, Junior or Secondary, and Gamma, Alpha or Sigma.
The placement is reviewed against a monthly benchmark and can change.

bring.heading: What to bring
bring.summary: The academy has not published a longer document checklist. Ask if you need a specific document before the diagnostic.
items: The student’s current class and school details.
A guardian email address and WhatsApp number.
Any past olympiad results or certificates you want considered (optional).
A notebook and pen for the diagnostic.
The written placement confirmation when attending the first class.

fees.heading: Fees
fees.summary: One monthly fee per subject. The fee does not change when a student is promoted.

items.label: Science
items.note: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and laboratory work.

items.label: Promotion
items.note: The same monthly fee applies after moving to a higher tier.

items.label: Scholarships
items.note: Merit scholarships and cash prizes are awarded at the Chairman’s discretion.

fees.paymentNote: The payment method and billing date are confirmed at placement. The academy has not published them on this site.

firstMonth.heading: The first month
firstMonth.summary: A clear sequence, so parents know what is happening and when the placement will be reviewed.

steps.label: Before class
steps.title: Application, diagnostic, written placement
steps.description: The batch, session and fee are confirmed before the student attends.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: First class and baseline problem set
steps.description: The mentor sees how the student works, not just what they already know.

steps.label: Weeks 2–3
steps.title: Weekly problem sets and feedback
steps.description: Sets are marked and returned. Mistakes are used as teaching material.

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: First monthly benchmark
steps.description: The benchmark checks whether the placement still fits. The top quartile may move up; a student who is slipping is re-placed.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and prizes
scholarships.summary: Merit scholarships and cash prizes are awarded separately at the Chairman’s discretion. They are not a standard discount and are not guaranteed.
scholarships.note: The academy has not published eligibility criteria or amounts. Ask at the campus or on WhatsApp.

visit.heading: Visiting before applying
visit.summary: Message on WhatsApp before visiting. The academy has not published fixed office hours, so a message is the reliable way to arrange a conversation.
visit.note: House 06, Road 1/1, Shekertek Adabor, Mohammadpur-1207, Dhaka.
